what: A glass dock at bottom center of the screen (30% background · 21.8px blur) — once you scroll past .6x of the Hero, the section links collapse to 0 width and transparent (.5s power3.inOut), a hamburger grows to 42px in their place .1s later, and the gap between cells shrinks from 50 → 30px. Pressing the hamburger collapses the header icon and CTA to 0 width (.4s), shrinks the dock to a single button size (gap 0 · 5px on the left), floats the menu panel above up from 16px below .15s later over .4s power3.out, and raises the links from 14px below .22s later with a .05s stagger over .35s power2.out. The icon scales to .5x and fades out in .25s power2.in, and the other icon pops out .12s later in .3s back.out(2). Closing runs in reverse (menu panel .28s power2.in). Clicking outside or pressing Esc closes it, and returning to the top expands it again.

options.at: Fold point — how many screen heights (or after-element heights) down, default .6
options.after: CSS selector of the Hero element to measure height from — screen height if omitted
options.menu: css selector for the menu board that floats above — if none, the child [data-fx-part=menu]. Better placed outside the dock so the glass blur doesn’t overlap
options.dur: Fold duration (seconds), default .5 — the other durations scale by the same ratio. 0 means instant
options.[data-fx-part=lead|links|toggle|cta]: Header mark · section link group · hamburger (inside it [data-key=menu]·[data-key=close] symbol) · CTA
